interpretive_caution.name: interpretive_caution
interpretive_caution.default: 'Scheda da leggere come tracciamento civico: la presenza nel registro non indica responsabilità o irregolarità accertate.'

crime_event_locations_coordinate_pair_ch.name: crime_event_locations_coordinate_pair_check
crime_event_locations_coordinate_pair_ch.value: ("crime_event_locations"."longitude" is null and "crime_event_locations"."latitude" is null) or ("crime_event_locations"."longitude" is not null and "crime_event_locations"."latitude" is not null)

crime_event_locations_coarse_point_check.name: crime_event_locations_coarse_point_check
crime_event_locations_coarse_point_check.value: "crime_event_locations"."resolved_precision" not in ('municipality','unknown') or ("crime_event_locations"."longitude" is null and "crime_event_locations"."latitude" is null)

crime_events_temporal_bounds_order_check.name: crime_events_temporal_bounds_order_check
crime_events_temporal_bounds_order_check.value: "crime_events"."temporal_start_bound" is null or "crime_events"."temporal_end_bound" is null or "crime_events"."temporal_end_bound" >= "crime_events"."temporal_start_bound"

legacy_subject_map_status_validity_check.name: legacy_subject_map_status_validity_check
legacy_subject_map_status_validity_check.value: ("legacy_subject_map"."mapping_status" = 'active' and "legacy_subject_map"."valid_to" is null) or ("legacy_subject_map"."mapping_status" = 'superseded' and "legacy_subject_map"."valid_to" is not null)

source_runs_counts.name: source_runs_counts
source_runs_counts.value: "source_acquisition_runs"."records_expected" >= 0 AND ("source_acquisition_runs"."records_inserted" IS NULL OR "source_acquisition_runs"."records_inserted" BETWEEN 0 AND "source_acquisition_runs"."records_expected") AND ("source_acquisition_runs"."records_verified" IS NULL OR "source_acquisition_runs"."records_verified" BETWEEN 0 AND "source_acquisition_runs"."records_expected")

source_runs_state.name: source_runs_state
source_runs_state.value: ("source_acquisition_runs"."status" = 'running' AND "source_acquisition_runs"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "source_acquisition_runs"."error_code" IS NULL) OR ("source_acquisition_runs"."status" = 'failed' AND "source_acquisition_runs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "source_acquisition_runs"."error_code" IS NOT NULL) OR ("source_acquisition_runs"."status" = 'succeeded' AND "source_acquisition_runs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "source_acquisition_runs"."error_code" IS NULL AND "source_acquisition_runs"."release_id" IS NOT NULL AND "source_acquisition_runs"."records_verified" IS NOT NULL AND "source_acquisition_runs"."records_inserted" IS NOT NULL AND "source_acquisition_runs"."records_verified" = "source_acquisition_runs"."records_expected")
